references.observations: H-E-B front packshot (960 px retailer render) of Diet Coke Twisted Mango. Tall, slim 12 fl oz sleek can in bright brushed silver with a single wide flavor-colored stripe running the full height of the front, centred, about 41 to 44 percent of the visible width. At the top of the stripe the flavor name in small white bold sans capitals; below it the Diet Coke wordmark in white, very large, reading bottom to top: script "Diet" followed on the same line by the heavy serif "Coke" with a registered mark. On the silver to the right a white "0 CALORIES PER CAN" lozenge above black "12 FL OZ (355 mL)"; at lower left a small red stacked Diet Coke logo with a black flavor descriptor. Stripe is mango yellow-orange (sampled #fbab1c). Name on two lines, TWISTED / MANGO. Illustration at the foot: an orange mango wedge in front with a fine pale outline and a silver dotted cut face below it, a second slice behind it rising to the upper right with white flesh and orange skin, and a small white-and-orange piece at the left.

Public-domain vector of the 2018 Diet Coke logo (file dated 2017-12-25): heavy serif "Coke" with a small script "Diet" stacked over the k and e. Rendered and compared with the wordmark cropped from the BevNET Ginger Lime photo: the letterforms match; the can sets the two words on one line with "Diet" about 1.7 times larger relative to "Coke", which is how they are placed here. The stacked arrangement is reused only for the small red logo at the foot of the can.

records.uncertainty: Body drawn at the house slim-can width (ratio 0.31, identical to the Good Celsius and Alani cans) although the photos measure 0.35 to 0.38. Wordmark letterforms are the 2018 logo vector re-set on one line; the size of "Diet" relative to "Coke" and all positions were measured on the BevNET Ginger Lime photo and reused for the four flavors. Flavor name is Arial Bold condensed with textLength (the can uses a geometric sans). "CALORIES PER CAN" and the flavor descriptor are reduced to hairlines; "12 FL OZ (355 mL)" is set small and heavily condensed. The house lid hides the top of the stripe, so the flavor name sits slightly lower than on the can. Historical package: the retailer and BevNET product pages the earlier batch recorded refuse automated requests, so the page recorded is the dated trade article that names the four flavors and the sleek 12 oz can; the image was opened directly. Discontinuation date not confirmed here. The mango pieces are filled slightly deeper than the stripe so they separate from it at tile size; the reference shows them almost the same orange with only a hairline outline.

references.observations: Retailer front packshot (1000 x 982) of the 12-pack carton with a single 12 oz can standing beside it, nearly straight on. Black can. Grey-tan root beer foam fills the top below the lid with a wavy lower edge and runs down both sides. A black shield with a thin gold keyline: an arched tab holding ZERO SUGAR in white condensed capitals, then the wide body holding MUG in heavy block capitals (white face fading to gold, olive bevel, dark outline) with the tan bulldog holding a foaming glass mug of root beer at lower right. Below, an upward-arched black banner with a gold edge holds ROOT BEER in white slab capitals. Lower body: dark glossy embossed mug-shaped panels separated by black gaps, and a gold NO CAFFEINE in bold capitals between two pairs of gold crescents. Shield, banner, text and oval positions were measured on this image; foam traced from it.

records.uncertainty: The catalog name reads Diet while the can reads ZERO SUGAR. The MUG letters, ZERO SUGAR and ROOT BEER were vectorised from the flat face of the 12-pack carton (same lettering; an Instacart image downloaded by the earlier agent, whose URL was not recorded) and then wrapped and placed to measurements on the can; ZERO SUGAR and ROOT BEER are set slightly larger on the can than on the carton, so each was scaled separately. The bulldog and his mug are traced from the 1000 px can packshot as eight flat tonal layers, so fur shading is posterised, the eyes are small light flecks and the amber root beer and glass handle are only roughly separated; the mid-tones were made about 18% more saturated than the cluster averages to keep the warm orange of the photo. The foam is one gradient shape with a few flecks for its bubbles, stretched slightly downward to clear the larger house lid. Shield keyline, banner, embossed panels and the NO CAFFEINE oval are hand drawn from measured points; the panels are flat rounded shapes with a faint highlight. NO CAFFEINE is Arial Bold fitted to the measured width (the can uses a rounded bold sans). The small registered mark is omitted.

CHERRY is drawn as stroked capitals and the two small lines are compressed Arial Bold Italic, both stand-ins for Coca-Cola's condensed face.
